scientific_question: Can a model trained in one gauge from initialization retain the accepted repaired-attention plus procedural-c_fc loss while replacing c_proj only in the late transformer band (layers 8-11)?
causal_rationale: The accepted c_fc-only 5TPP parent reaches validation CE 3.625838041305542 with dense c_proj.

Replacing c_proj in all twelve layers raises terminal CE to 3.660243, while the prospective depth diagnostic found no locally destructive four-layer band and instead localized the defect to accumulated full-depth propagation.

Post-hoc c_proj and whole-MLP donor transplantation failed because independently trained runs are globally co-adapted; those failures do not test a mixed architecture trained jointly from initialization.

A fixed GPT-initialized dense base plus a zero-initialized BlockFHT delta was already rejected, and rematching c_proj topology every update already removed simple chart staleness. This experiment is therefore layer-wise allocation, not another initialization, refresh, scalar, or static-basis sweep.

candidate.c_fc: unchanged accepted directed-product [22,22,22,22,22,22], radius 1.0, error-feedback decay 1.0 in all 12 layers
candidate.procedural_c_proj: unchanged hidden64 plus residual24 Muon-matched Givens with error-feedback decay 0.5
candidate.training_gauge: Every layer is initialized and optimized jointly in the same run; no checkpoint tensor is transplanted.
candidate.inference: All c_proj weights are materialized dense GEMM weights; no extra inference operation is added.
forbidden_additions: global scale, volume, shear, gain, or activation modification
post-hoc donor tensor or module transplantation

implementation_contract.empty_field_backward_compatibility: An empty list retains the historical all-layer behavior.
implementation_contract.validation: Configured layer IDs must be unique integers in [0,n_layer). The field is invalid unless Muon-matched c_proj is enabled and mlp.c_proj is a target.
implementation_contract.construction: Only selected layers construct MuonMatchedGivensLinear c_proj modules. Unselected layers construct ordinary dense nn.Linear c_proj modules even though mlp.c_proj remains a global target for the selected layers.
implementation_contract.optimizer: Selected c_proj modules use the existing custom Muon-matched optimizer; dense c_proj layers remain ordinary Muon-owned matrices.
implementation_contract.resume: Module identity and layer mask are part of the resolved config and exact-resume checkpoint identity.

performance_gate.mode: foreground exact scientific config with real optimizer updates; poll directly and use no watchdog

decision_rule.curve_guard: At steps 594, 1188, 1782, and 2373, candidate validation CE must not exceed the all-layer procedural control at the same step by more than 0.005.
decision_rule.pass_action: Accept late-band LWT replacement as a partial full-MLP structure and preregister one expansion to procedural c_proj layers 4-11 at the same 5TPP horizon; no larger model is automatically authorized.
decision_rule.fail_action: Close four-layer late-band c_proj replacement. Do not infer that a smaller two-layer band passes and do not launch an automatic retry, layer sweep, or larger rung.

monitoring.callback_action_prompt: verify terminal state and exact artifacts against the active project note; seal losses, mask identity, optimizer ownership, MFU, provenance, and hashes; then continue the layer-wise MLP research plan autonomously
